findings.title: verify-only still accepts non-canonical row counts
findings.description: verify_dataset_shape enforces exact ordered columns but only rejects empty data. It never checks the required 140352 train rows and 39152 test rows. A truncated or otherwise wrong-size 37-column artifact with matching output hashes passes verify-only, and the added eight-row test demonstrates this gap. Add exact row-count checks and regression tests for both files.

findings.title: verify-only does not validate the emitted contract digest
findings.description: The builder emits a hash over the full manifest contract, but verify-only checks only selected fields and output hashes. A changed coverage, source, target, build-parameter, or nested/top-level contract field can pass if output hashes remain current. Recompute and compare contract_digest, and require one canonical manifest layout.

findings.title: Replacement rollback leaves a manifest for unpublished outputs
findings.description: The manifest is overwritten with staged output hashes before the two target replacements. If the second replace fails, train is restored and test remains old, but the manifest remains new. A subsequent verify-only run then reports hash mismatch, and an existing manifest has been lost. Publish or rollback the manifest together with the tape pair, or defer and transactionally handle its publication.

findings.title: Custom output parents are created too late
findings.description: NamedTemporaryFile requires output_train.parent and output_test.parent to exist, but mkdir is called only after both temporary files are created at lines 269-270. A valid custom output path in a new directory fails before staging. Create the parents before opening temporary files.

findings.title: Default no-replace failures leave stale staged files
findings.description: When no --replace flag and no custom outputs are supplied, default .staged.csv files are created but the exception cleanup skips them because both is_custom flags are false. They are ignored by git but can be mistaken for a successful build; clean default staging paths on every failure.

notes: The six requested fixes are largely present and the package reports its verification suite passed, but independent source review found a blocking verify-only row-count gap and a blocking manifest/tape publication inconsistency on replacement failure. The contract-digest, custom-parent, and default-staging cleanup gaps are recorded as additional non-blocking findings. Untracked .antigravity/.opencode scratch is excluded from the tracked review.
